name: SendGrid
label: SendGrid — Twilio SendGrid Web API v3
description: SendGrid v3 at https://api.sendgrid.com. Docs: https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/mail-send/mail-send. send-email takes flat to/cc/bcc/from/subject/text/html and nests them into personalizations[0] / from.email / content[0]|[1] via bodyMap. Bearer api_key. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Never log api_key or message bodies.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One SendGrid operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"send-email"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: send-email | upsert-contact | get-contact | list-contacts | delete-contact | create-list | get-list | list-lists | update-list | delete-list | listen. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: from
schema.description: send-email verified sender email. Wired to from.email. Required. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: from_name
schema.description: send-email from display name. Wired to from.name. Example: Ada.

schema.label: to
schema.description: send-email recipient email. Wired to personalizations[0].to[0].email. Required unless using the personalizations object escape hatch. Example: bob@example.com.

schema.label: cc
schema.description: send-email CC email. Wired to personalizations[0].cc[0].email. Example: cc@example.com.

schema.label: bcc
schema.description: send-email BCC email. Wired to personalizations[0].bcc[0].email. Example: bcc@example.com.

schema.label: subject
schema.description: send-email subject (root). Example: Your receipt.

schema.label: text
schema.description: send-email plain body. Wired to content[0].value. content[0].type comes from config text_type (default text/plain). HTML-only: set text too or use the content escape hatch — mapping html to content[1] leaves an empty content[0] slot if text is omitted.

schema.label: html
schema.description: send-email HTML body. Wired to content[1].value. content[1].type comes from config html_type (default text/html).

schema.label: text_type
schema.description: send-email content[0].type. Config default text/plain. Override only if you need a different MIME type.

schema.label: html_type
schema.description: send-email content[1].type. Config default text/html.

schema.label: content
schema.description: send-email one content-part object escape hatch {type,value} merged into content[0]. Prefer text/html purpose fields (types from config defaults). Example: {"type":"text/plain","value":"Hi"}.

schema.label: personalizations
schema.description: send-email personalizations object escape hatch (first item). Extra keys merge into personalizations[0]; named to/cc/bcc win. For many recipients send this as one personalization object {to:[{email}]}. Example: {"to":[{"email":"bob@example.com"}]}.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Contact or list UUID. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: ids
schema.description: Comma-separated contact UUIDs for delete-contact. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Marketing list name. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: attachments
schema.description: send-email attachments [{content (base64), filename, type, disposition}]. Do not log content.

schema.label: contacts
schema.description: upsert-contact contacts array (required). Each: email (required), first_name, last_name, custom_fields.

schema.label: list_ids
schema.description: upsert-contact list_ids to add the contacts to. UUID strings.

schema.label: page_size
schema.description: Query-string parameter `page_size` for operation: list-lists.

schema.label: page_token
schema.description: Query-string parameter `page_token` for operation: list-lists.

schema.label: delete_contacts
schema.description: Query-string parameter `delete_contacts` for operation: delete-list.

schema.label: reply_to
schema.description: send-email reply_to {email, name}.

schema.label: template_id
schema.description: Dynamic template id for send-email. When set, content may be omitted; use personalizations.dynamic_template_data.

schema.label: categories
schema.description: send-email categories (strings, max 10).

schema.label: send_at
schema.description: send-email unix send_at (not more than 72h).

schema.label: asm
schema.description: send-email ASM group {group_id, groups_to_display}.

schema.label: mail_settings
schema.description: send-email mail_settings object.

schema.label: tracking_settings
schema.description: send-email tracking_settings object.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: send-email, upsert-contact, get-contact, list-contacts, delete-contact, create-list, get-list, list-lists, update-list, delete-list, listen. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.
